<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Electoral Integrity Disputes:</strong> Political parties are raising concerns over electoral processes, including allegations of voter removal in Maharashtra and disputes over nomination transparency in Rajasthan and TMC-related matters.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Economic and Governance Debates:</strong> The BJP has demanded an apology from Rahul Gandhi regarding his economic critiques following India&#x27;s reported 7.8% GDP growth, while opposition leaders continue to challenge the government on corruption and governance.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxQdTY1MFlTTG1SUDBiVVctQVJJVlFaNy0yQXVsUWVOZ0NsX2tMOUpSVVhoWFUwVUJDTjY0MlpiX216QzZaMGNEZlJTd29NVjZuZEg5dm5RZkNYZHpkdFNUN1dVYjZScHZsbjNXMGF2YzdjMXprVW1VS1hCN1hSXzhBU2dVTjVwTWxEYzJuNW5seHB3Tlk4N3I1Zlp3QlB3UzBaRGt3aXV5NWlNQTZUaXZmdG1HQzdLSGhKdHVnU0ZB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial and Administrative Actions:</strong> The Supreme Court has dismissed a plea for mandatory ethanol content disclosure in petrol, even as a judicial panel proposes a roadmap for modernizing court funding.</li>
</ul>
